name: Animate Objects
description: Nonmagical objects sprout legs and come alive under your command, using a single Animated Object stat block (AC 15). You can animate a number of objects equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (Medium counts as one, Large as two, Huge as three), and each makes Slam attacks dealing force damage by size (1d4 + 3, 2d6 + 3 + modifier, or 2d12 + 3 + modifier); upcasting increases the Slam damage.

name: Antilife Shell
description: A shimmering 10-foot emanation hedges out living creatures: anything other than a Construct or an Undead cannot enter it, and the barrier moves with you, collapsing if you force it against a creature it would exclude.

name: Awaken
description: After tracing runes around an agate, you grant a Beast or Plant with Intelligence 3 or less true sentience: Intelligence 10, the ability to speak a language you know, and keen senses. A plant gains the ability to move and manipulate its limbs, and an awakened Beast is Charmed by you for 30 days or until you or your allies harm it.

name: Banishing Smite
description: Cast as a bonus action right after you hit with a weapon: the target takes an extra 5d10 force damage, and if it has 50 hit points or fewer it makes a Charisma save or is banished to a harmless demiplane.

name: Bigby's Hand
description: You conjure a Large hand of shimmering energy (AC 20, hit points equal to your maximum) that you direct as a bonus action. Its Clenched Fist makes a melee spell attack for 5d8 force damage, its Forceful Hand shoves a creature that fails a Strength save, its Grasping Hand grapples on a failed Dexterity save and can crush for 4d6 + your modifier bludgeoning damage, and its Interposing Hand grants you cover.

name: Circle of Power
description: Divine energy radiates from you in a 30-foot emanation that moves with you. Allies within it have advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects, and when such an effect allows a successful save to take only half damage, an ally that succeeds takes no damage instead.

name: Cloudkill
description: Yellowish-green poison fog fills a 20-foot-radius sphere, heavily obscuring it and rolling 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns, sinking around corners and through openings. Creatures in it when it appears, when they first enter it on a turn, or when they end their turn there make a Constitution save, taking 5d8 poison damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Commune
description: You contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no, receiving a correct answer (or an unclear one if the being does not know). Casting it again before a long rest risks a garbled or random reading.

name: Commune with Nature
description: You briefly merge with nature and learn up to three facts about the surrounding terrain (a 3-mile radius outdoors, or 300 feet underground): the lay of the land, prevalent plants, minerals or animals, powerful magical beings, influential planar forces, or settlements and structures.

name: Cone of Cold
description: A blast of freezing air erupts from your hands in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution save, taking 8d8 cold damage on a failure or half on a success, and a creature killed by the blast becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.

name: Conjure Elemental
description: You conjure an intangible Large elemental spirit of air (lightning), earth (thunder), fire (fire), or water (cold). While it holds no creature Restrained, a creature that enters its space or starts its turn within 5 feet of it makes a Dexterity save or takes 8d8 damage of the chosen type and is Restrained; a restrained creature repeats the save at the start of each of its turns, taking 4d8 damage on a failure and breaking free on a success.

name: Conjure Volley
description: You fire a piece of ammunition or throw a weapon skyward and a rain of spectral copies falls in a 40-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d8 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Contact Other Plane
description: You reach across the planes to a demigod, dead sage, or stranger entity. Make an Intelligence save when you cast it: on a failure you take 6d6 psychic damage and are driven mad until a long rest, but on a success you can ask five questions, answered in single words (or short phrases when a word would mislead).

name: Contagion
description: Your touch seeds a magical contagion. The target makes a Constitution save or takes 11d8 necrotic damage and gains the Poisoned condition, and while poisoned it has disadvantage on saving throws with one ability you chose when casting. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns: three successes end the spell early, while three failures lock the contagion in for the full 7 days.

name: Creation
description: You pull strands of shadow-stuff from the Shadowfell and weave them into a nonmagical object of vegetable matter in a space up to a 5-foot cube. The creation lasts from 10 minutes to a full day depending on the material mimicked, and can serve as the material component for another casting of this spell.

name: Destructive Wave
damage: 5d6 thunder + 5d6 radiant or necrotic (chosen when cast)
description: You slam the ground and a wave of divine energy bursts out to 30 feet. Each creature you choose in the area makes a Constitution save, taking 5d6 thunder damage plus 5d6 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice when casting) on a failure and falling Prone, or half as much damage on a success.

name: Dispel Evil and Good
description: Shimmering power wards you against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead: they attack you at disadvantage and cannot Charm, Frighten, or possess you. By touch you can end one such effect on a creature, or attempt a dismissal: the creature makes a Charisma save or is sent back to its home plane.

name: Dominate Person
description: You seize control of a Humanoid that fails a Wisdom save: it is Charmed, linked to you telepathically, and obeys your commands, though you can also seize direct control with your action. It repeats the save each time it takes damage, and higher-level slots stretch the domination to hours.

name: Dream
description: You send a messenger into the dreams of a sleeping creature on your plane, shaping the dream and conversing through it. You can instead make the messenger monstrous: when the target wakes it makes a Wisdom save or takes 3d6 psychic damage and gains no benefit from that rest.

name: Flame Strike
description: A column of divine flame roars down in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity save, taking 5d6 fire damage plus 5d6 radiant damage on a failure, or half as much on a success; upcasting adds 1d6 to each damage type.

name: Geas
description: You lay a magical command on a creature that can understand you: carry out a service, or refrain from an action, as you direct. On a failed Wisdom save it is Charmed for the duration, and each day it acts against your instructions it takes 5d10 psychic damage (no more than once per day); higher-level slots extend the geas to a year or make it last until ended.

name: Greater Restoration
description: Soothing energy washes through a creature you touch, consuming diamond dust to undo one great affliction: end the Charmed or Petrified condition, lift a curse, restore a reduced ability score or hit point maximum, or reduce its exhaustion by one level.

name: Hallow
description: You consecrate ground in a 60-foot-radius sphere. Creature types you choose cannot willingly enter, and those inside are shielded from being Charmed, Frightened, or possessed by them, and corpses in the area cannot become Undead. You also bind one extra effect to the ground — such as silence, darkness, fear, or everlasting rest.

name: Hold Monster
description: A creature of your choice that you can see freezes in place on a failed Wisdom save, gaining the Paralyzed condition; it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Each higher-level slot lets you bind one additional creature.

name: Insect Plague
description: A swarming cloud of biting locusts fills a 20-foot-radius sphere, lightly obscuring it and making it difficult terrain. A creature makes a Constitution save when the swarm appears on it, when it first enters on a turn, or when it ends its turn there, taking 4d10 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success.

name: Legend Lore
description: You name a person, place, or object of legendary importance and receive a summary of the significant lore about it, gathered from sources you may never have seen. The more you already know of the subject, the more detailed and precise the lore.

name: Mass Cure Wounds
description: A wave of healing washes over a point you choose: up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere there each regain 5d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. Each higher-level slot adds 1d8 to the healing.

name: Mislead
description: You gain the Invisible condition and an illusory double of you appears where you stood, moving and sounding as you direct. At any time you can see and hear through the double instead of yourself.

name: Modify Memory
description: You reach into the recent past of a creature that fails a Wisdom save: it is Charmed while you spend the spell reciting an altered version of up to 10 minutes of its last day, and it afterward believes the new memory, rationally filling any gaps.

name: Passwall
description: A passage appears in a wooden, plaster, or stone surface you can see: 5 feet wide, 8 feet tall, and up to 20 feet deep, with no damage to the surrounding structure. When the spell ends, the opening closes and anything still inside is shunted to the nearest open space.

name: Planar Binding
description: You bind a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend to your service: it makes a Charisma save, and on a failure it must obey your instructions for the duration (a creature summoned by another spell must already be present when you begin). Higher-level slots stretch the binding to days, weeks, or half a year.

name: Raise Dead
description: You call back the willing soul of a creature dead no longer than 10 days, closing its mortal wounds as it returns to life with 1 hit point. Coming back is an ordeal: the restored creature takes a -4 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks that shrinks by 1 after each long rest.

name: Rary's Telepathic Bond
description: You weave a telepathic link among up to eight willing creatures in range. For the duration they can communicate telepathically with one another through the bond, no matter the distance, as long as they remain on the same plane.

name: Reincarnate
description: You touch a Humanoid dead no longer than 10 days and call its soul back into a brand-new adult body grown from rare oils and unguents. The new body is of a species determined by rolling on the spell table, and the soul must be free and willing to return.

name: Scrying
description: You gaze through a crystal ball, mirror, or holy-water font at a creature on your plane: unless it succeeds on a Wisdom save (modified by how well you know it and whether you have a piece of its body), you watch and listen to it and its surroundings through an invisible sensor.

name: Seeming
description: You rewrite how any number of creatures in range look, sound, and feel — clothing, armor, weapons, size, even apparent species. Unwilling creatures resist with a Charisma save, and the illusion is given away by physical interaction or a successful Study action against your spell save DC.

name: Swift Quiver
description: Your quiver becomes a blur: as part of the bonus action used to cast the spell, and as a bonus action on your later turns, you can make two attacks with a weapon that uses ammunition from the quiver, which magically produces an endless supply of nonmagical ammunition for them.

name: Telekinesis
description: You move creatures and objects by thought alone, exerting your will when you cast the spell and as a Magic action on later turns. A Huge or smaller creature must succeed on a Strength save or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction and held Restrained in your grip until the end of your next turn; unattended objects move automatically, and you can also manipulate tools, doors, and containers with fine control.

name: Teleportation Circle
description: You inscribe a circle of sigils that links to a permanent teleportation circle whose sequence you know, on your plane or another. A portal opens above the circle for 1 round, and any creature that enters it is whisked instantly to the destination circle.

name: Tree Stride
description: You step into a living tree and emerge from another tree of the same kind within 500 feet. You can make the hop once per turn, and you always know the approximate location and health of the nearest suitable trees.

name: Wall of Force
description: An invisible wall of force springs into existence — ten 10-foot panels, a 10-foot-radius sphere, or a hemisphere — immune to all damage and impassable to creatures, objects, and spell effects alike. Only disintegrate destroys it outright.

name: Wall of Stone
description: A solid wall of nonmagical stone rises in ten 10-foot panels; a creature in the space where the wall appears can make a Dexterity save to escape to one side instead of being trapped. The wall has AC 15 and hit points by thickness, and if you hold concentration for the full duration it becomes permanent and undispellable.
